content: River (Go+Postgres): claim uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; a per-process 'producer' consolidates locking for all internal executor goroutines (batch-claim then fan out in-process). Default wakeup is Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY (sub-ms dispatch, fires post-commit so crash-safe) with periodic polling (FetchPollInterval) as correctness backstop/fallback - never poll-only or notify-only by default.
